candidates.snippet: The elections in Samara went smoothly - although, for some reason, the locals didn’t appreciate the festive display put on by the Ukrainian drones. https://t.co/5NsBVs7UUQ

Russia has introduced temporary 10-day restrictions in border areas near Estonia. In a 5-kilometer zone along the border, nighttime movement outside populated areas has been banned. Authorities also restricted the movement of small watercraft along a specific section of the Narva
